description: This file is a PHP script used within the TestLink open source testing management system. It retrieves and processes a summary of a specific test case for display purposes, particularly for rendering in a tooltip via ExtJS. It interacts with the database through a test case manager object, handles request parameters, and formats the output summary.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class responsible for managing test case data within the database, including fetching test case information by ID and version.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Fetches a specific version of a test case by its ID.

methods.name: get_last_version_info
methods.description: Retrieves the latest version information of a test case.
